# Beequation

> Beequation is a mental maths puzzle game by Trett Labs Limited (UK). Each honeycomb of numbers hides exactly one number that two others add up to (or multiply to); the player finds and taps it. There are two apps: Beequation Kids (ages 5 to 12) and Beequation Pro (teens and adults), plus a free browser version. No ads, no tracking, no personal data collected; free to try, with a monthly or yearly subscription (7-day free trial) or a one-off Lifetime purchase to unlock every level.

- [Play free online](https://beequation.com/play.html): the browser game, with both the kids and adult versions
- [How to play](https://beequation.com/how-to-play.html): rules, worked examples and tips
- [Free puzzles for teachers](https://beequation.com/teachers.html): printable pack for number bonds to 20 and the 2 to 6 times tables
- [Number bonds to 20: a guide for parents and teachers](https://beequation.com/learn/number-bonds-to-20.html): What number bonds to 10 and 20 are, when children learn them, how to practise them at home or in class, and free honeycomb puzzles that make it fun.
- [Fun ways to practise times tables](https://beequation.com/learn/times-tables-practice.html): Which times tables children learn in each year, what the Year 4 multiplication tables check involves, and quick, fun ways to practise, including free puzzles.
- [Mental maths strategies that really work](https://beequation.com/learn/mental-maths-strategies.html): Eight mental maths strategies for adding, subtracting and multiplying in your head, from bridging through 10 to doubling and halving, with worked examples.
- [A daily maths puzzle for adults](https://beequation.com/learn/daily-maths-puzzle-for-adults.html): Why a short daily number puzzle is a satisfying way to keep your mental arithmetic sharp, and how the Daily Pro, blitz and expert levels in Beequation Pro work.
- [Support](https://beequation.com/support.html): purchases, players, refunds and resetting progress
- [Privacy policy](https://beequation.com/privacy.html): the apps collect no personal data
- [About](https://beequation.com/about.html): who makes Beequation

## Learn

Free primary maths guides and worksheets for parents and teachers (Reception to Year 6, National Curriculum in England).

- [Learn maths with Indie](https://beequation.com/learn/): Free primary maths help from Reception to Year 6: topic guides, year-by-year guides, printable worksheets with answers and advice for parents and teachers.
- [Maths glossary](https://beequation.com/learn/glossary/): Primary maths words explained in plain English, from acute angle to zero, each with a worked example and the year children meet it, Reception to Year 6.
- [Maths in everyday life: 38 quick activities](https://beequation.com/learn/parents/everyday-maths.html): 38 quick ways to practise maths in everyday life with children aged 4 to 11, using cooking, shopping, travel, games, time and money, sorted by age.
- [How to help your child with maths at home](https://beequation.com/learn/parents/helping-at-home.html): Practical ways for parents to help with primary maths at home: little and often, good questions, praising effort, homework and methods you don't know.
- [How maths is taught in primary schools now](https://beequation.com/learn/parents/how-maths-is-taught.html): How primary maths is taught now, for parents: ten frames, part-whole models, number lines, column methods, bus stop division and bar models explained.
- [Maths help for parents](https://beequation.com/learn/parents/): Guides for parents and carers: helping with maths at home, how primary maths is taught now, SATs and the times tables check, and maths anxiety.
- [Helping a child who says "I'm bad at maths"](https://beequation.com/learn/parents/maths-anxiety.html): What to do when your child says they're bad at maths: signs of maths anxiety, words that help, your own feelings, low-stakes games and talking to teachers.
- [Primary school maths tests explained](https://beequation.com/learn/parents/maths-tests-explained.html): Every primary maths test in England, from the Reception Baseline to Year 6 SATs: when they happen, what scores mean and how parents can help calmly.
- [Differentiation in maths](https://beequation.com/learn/teachers/differentiation-in-maths.html): Practical differentiation in primary maths for teachers: keeping the class together, manipulatives, scaffolds, low threshold high ceiling tasks.
- [Maths resources for teachers](https://beequation.com/learn/teachers/): Free primary maths resources for teachers, Reception to Year 6: starters, classroom games, reasoning activities, differentiation ideas and free worksheets.
- [Maths games for the classroom](https://beequation.com/learn/teachers/maths-games-for-the-classroom.html): 15 low-prep maths games for KS1 and KS2 classrooms: whole-class, pair and group games with rules, what each one practises and how to adapt it.
- [25 quick maths starters](https://beequation.com/learn/teachers/maths-starters.html): 25 quick maths starters for primary teachers, grouped for KS1, lower KS2 and upper KS2. Each takes 5 to 10 minutes and needs little preparation.
- [Reasoning and problem solving](https://beequation.com/learn/teachers/reasoning-and-problem-solving.html): Build reasoning and problem solving in primary maths: question stems, true or false, spot the mistake, open problems and bar models, Reception to Year 6.
- [Addition and subtraction](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/addition-and-subtraction.html): How children learn addition and subtraction, Reception to Year 6: number bonds, mental methods, number lines and column methods, with free worksheets.
- [Algebra and ratio](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/algebra-and-ratio.html): How children learn early algebra and ratio, Reception to Year 6: missing numbers, sequences, unknowns, formulas, ratio and scaling, with free worksheets.
- [Counting and place value](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/counting-and-place-value.html): How children learn counting and place value, Reception to Year 6: ones, tens and hundreds to millions, rounding, negative numbers, with free worksheets.
- [Data and graphs](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/data-and-graphs.html): How children learn data and graphs from Year 2 to Year 6: pictograms, tally charts, bar charts, line graphs, pie charts and the mean, with free worksheets.
- [Decimals and percentages](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/decimals-and-percentages.html): How children learn decimals and percentages, Year 3 to Year 6: tenths, hundredths, rounding, percentages of amounts and equivalents, with free worksheets.
- [Fractions](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/fractions.html): How children learn fractions from Year 1 to Year 6: halves and quarters, equivalent fractions, adding and simplifying, with mistakes and free worksheets.
- [Maths topics](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/): Twelve guides to primary maths topics, from counting to algebra and ratio: what children learn each year, with common mistakes, games and free worksheets.
- [Measurement](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/measurement.html): How children learn measurement, Reception to Year 6: length, mass, capacity, scales, converting units, perimeter, area and volume, with free worksheets.
- [Mental maths](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/mental-maths.html): Mental maths for children, Reception to Year 6: why it matters, the strategies they learn, number facts to know by heart, with games and free worksheets.
- [Money](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/money.html): How children learn about money from Year 1 to Year 6: UK coins and notes, pounds and pence, giving change and shopping problems, with free worksheets.
- [Multiplication and division](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/multiplication-and-division.html): How children learn multiplication and division, Reception to Year 6: arrays, times tables, the Year 4 check, long multiplication, with free worksheets.
- [Shape and geometry](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/shape-and-geometry.html): How children learn shape and geometry, Reception to Year 6: 2D and 3D shapes, symmetry, angles, coordinates, reflection, with games and free worksheets.
- [Telling the time](https://beequation.com/learn/topics/telling-the-time.html): How children learn to tell the time, Year 1 to Year 6: o'clock, quarter past and to, am and pm, the 24-hour clock and durations, with free worksheets.
- [Free maths worksheets](https://beequation.com/learn/worksheets/): Free printable primary maths worksheets with answers: number bonds, times tables, column methods, fractions, time, money and shapes, by topic and year.
- [Maths by year group](https://beequation.com/learn/years/): What children learn in primary maths each year, from Reception (age 4 to 5) to Year 6 (age 10 to 11), with US grades, key tests and free worksheets.
- [Reception maths: what your child learns (age 4 to 5)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/reception.html): What children learn in Reception maths (age 4 to 5): EYFS Early Learning Goals, counting, subitising, number bonds to 10 and doubling, with ideas for home.
- [Year 1 maths: what your child learns (age 5 to 6)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/year-1.html): What children learn in Year 1 maths (age 5 to 6): counting to 100, number bonds to 20, halves and quarters, coins, o'clock and shapes, with worksheets.
- [Year 2 maths: what your child learns (age 6 to 7)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/year-2.html): What children learn in Year 2 maths (age 6 to 7): tens and ones, adding to 100, the 2, 5 and 10 times tables, fractions, money, time and KS1 SATs.
- [Year 3 maths: what your child learns (age 7 to 8)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/year-3.html): What children learn in Year 3 maths (age 7 to 8): numbers to 1,000, column methods, the 3, 4 and 8 times tables, fractions, perimeter and 24-hour time.
- [Year 4 maths: what your child learns (age 8 to 9)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/year-4.html): What children learn in Year 4 maths (age 8 to 9): times tables to 12 × 12, the Multiplication Tables Check, negative numbers, decimals, area and symmetry.
- [Year 5 maths: what your child learns (age 9 to 10)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/year-5.html): What children learn in Year 5 maths (age 9 to 10): numbers to a million, long multiplication, prime and square numbers, decimals, percentages and angles.
- [Year 6 maths: what your child learns (age 10 to 11)](https://beequation.com/learn/years/year-6.html): What children learn in Year 6 maths (age 10 to 11): long division, fractions, percentages, ratio, algebra, area and volume, and the KS2 SATs.
